description: Pre-action risk gate for deploys, publishes, merges, DB migrations, key rotation, destructive commands, and production work. Returns allow, warn, review_required, or block plus prior lessons/playbooks.

action.description: What the agent is about to do.

context.description: Optional metadata. Do not include secrets or raw payloads.

description.description: Optional extra context for the action.

requiresApproval.description: Set true when owner approval is required before proceeding.

riskTolerance.description: Default high. Use medium/low for stricter gates.

name: marrow_workflow_gate
